name: Steve Gaines
caption: A brash singles wrestler who won the GCW Glory Championship from Hussar in a contested main event.

tenures.source: Won the GCW Glory Championship from the defending champion Hussar on the promotion's own 2 August 1999 broadcast.

name: Hussar
caption: A masked hired gun for the stable called the Mercenaries who lost the GCW Glory Championship to Steve Gaines in a contested finish.

tenures.source: Defended and lost the GCW Glory Championship against Steve Gaines on the promotion's own 2 August 1999 broadcast.

name: Sean Murphy
caption: A tag-team wrestler billed as GCW Glory Champion in a January 1999 broadcast.

tenures.source: Billed as the reigning GCW Glory Champion, teaming with Shawn Hudson in a tag match on the promotion's own 28 January 1999 broadcast.

name: Romeo Ramirez
caption: A wrestler billed as the reigning GCW Southern Heritage Champion in a January 1999 broadcast.

tenures.source: Billed as the reigning GCW Southern Heritage Champion, teaming with Goliath in a tag match on the promotion's own 28 January 1999 broadcast.

name: Vatch Indesson
caption: A wrestler who claimed the GCW Southern Heritage Championship the week before the promotion's own 2 August 1999 broadcast, defeating a field of contenders.

tenures.source: Presented as the new GCW Southern Heritage Champion, and recaps in his own words winning the title the week before by beating Paul Riser and several other contenders, on the promotion's own 2 August 1999 broadcast.
